description: React component for displaying and interacting with post reactions in Mattermost, including reaction count, user reactions, and accessibility features.

classes.name: Reaction
classes.description: React component managing reaction display, user interactions, and accessibility for post reactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state based on whether the current user has reacted.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates reaction count and class when props change.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles user click to add or remove reaction, with animation control.

methods.name: handleAnimationEnded
methods.description: Finalizes reaction state after animation and triggers add/remove reaction actions.

methods.name: loadMissingProfiles
methods.description: Loads user profiles for reactions if missing.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders reaction button with emoji, count, and accessibility labels.
